test.//: Override of the inferred `test` target (dependsOn only; executor/cache/outputs come from inference — the @nx/vitest plugin replaces main's removed `@nx/vite:test` executor, and its coverage output matches vite.config.ts's reportsDirectory, which main's explicit output did not). Backlog's OWN `build` + `assets` are load-bearing: the MCP-stdio (server.mcp.spec.ts) and published-layout specs spawn/read the real built dist/, and `assets` (BUG-013 FIX A) is what copies dist/skill/SKILL.md in. `vocabulary-gate` (C-22) makes both vocabulary acceptance gates run on every `nx affected -t test`. `lint`/`^build` mirror the workspace `test` targetDefaults, which an explicit dependsOn otherwise replaces.

vocabulary-gate.//: C-22: both vocabulary acceptance gates, as one Nx task. `tools/gate/vocabulary-gate.mjs` scans src/ (code AND text assets such as src/write/CONTRACT.md) plus the package's top-level markdown (SPEC/DESIGN/DATA_MODEL/RAG-SPEC/README/CHANGELOG); `scripts/check-vocabulary.mjs` npm-packs the REAL artifact (package.json `files`: dist + CHANGELOG.md + skill) and scans the tarball — the only scan that catches a banned token reaching a consumer through dist/*.d.ts, which reproduces source doc comments verbatim and never appears in src/. Wired into test.dependsOn so the PR workflows' `nx affected -t test` runs it on every PR touching this package. dependsOn build+assets so the packed artifact is the real shipped one, never a stale dist/. cache:true mirrors the verify-dist-load convention — deterministic given `inputs: ["default"]`: a src/doc change re-runs it, and a dist/ change re-runs it too because nx folds the build/assets dependency task hashes into this task's hash, so dist/ (a dependency OUTPUT, not an input) needs no explicit input entry. NOTE: check-vocabulary.mjs takes NO path arg here deliberately — cwd is already {projectRoot} and the script defaults to process.cwd(); passing {projectRoot} again double-prefixes the path, npm pack spawns with a nonexistent cwd, and the failure surfaces as the misleading 'spawnSync npm ENOENT' (verified while authoring this target).

metadata.description: Runs both vocabulary acceptance gates (src-tree scan + packed-tarball scan); non-zero exit on any banned humanId/migration/sqlite reference anywhere, and on v1/v2 outside generated bundles. Runs on every PR touching the package via test.dependsOn.

assets.//: BUG-013 FIX A hardening (original): the globally-inferred @adhd/nx-assets:copy target (tools/nx-plugins/assets/plugin.js) declares NO `outputs` at all, so a later cache HIT on THIS project's `build` target (whose own declared `outputs` is the whole `dist/` dir) silently restores build's own cached dist/ SNAPSHOT — taken before `assets` ever ran — wiping whatever `assets` had already copied in (dist/skill/, dist/README.md, dist/CHANGELOG.md), with no re-copy on `assets`'s own subsequent cache hit (nothing declared to restore). Declaring explicit `outputs`/`inputs` here was meant to fix that. Scoped to backlog only — the SAME underlying gap (already tracked as BUG-BUILD-ASSETS-CACHE-STALE-AFTER-CLEAN-001, tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/manifest) affects every OTHER `assets`-consuming project too, worked around there only for the publish/manifest path.
assets.//bug-026: BUG-026 FIX: the original fix above set `outputs: ["{projectRoot}/dist"]` — the WHOLE directory, the exact same literal path `build`'s own outputs (`{options.outputPath}`) claims. nx's cache restore for a directory-shaped output does `remove(dir); copy(cachedDir, dir)` (node_modules/nx/src/tasks-runner/cache.js `copyFilesFromCache`) — a full SWAP, not a merge. `test`'s dependsOn is `["^build", "build", "assets", "vocabulary-gate"]` (vocabulary-gate added C-22; it depends on build+assets itself and owns no dist outputs, so it does not participate in the swap ordering): when only `build`'s inputs change (source fix, cache MISS -> fresh rebuild) while `assets`'s own inputs (README/CHANGELOG/skill/package.json) don't (cache HIT), nx restores `assets`'s STALE recorded snapshot of the ENTIRE dist dir over the freshly-built one, silently reverting `dist/index.js` to whatever it was when `assets` last ran (measured 2026-08-18: a 4-day-stale artifact missing BUG-020's fix). FIX: scope `outputs` to ONLY the files this target's own executor (tools/nx-plugins/assets/executors/copy/impl.js) actually writes — never the bare shared `dist` directory `build` also owns. Regression test: tools/nx-plugins/build/bug-026-assets-output-scope.spec.mjs (reads this exact config live).

serve.//: web UI prototype: spawns the real built CLI (`serve --transport http`) + a static/proxy web server (tools/run-web-ui.mjs) and owns both lifecycles. `nx serve backlog` then `open http://127.0.0.1:4173/`. Pass-through flags (e.g. `--sandbox` for an isolated store) go after `--`: `npx nx serve backlog -- --sandbox`. Long-lived dev process — never cacheable.
